pages.title: Croke Park 3D Puzzle
pages.description: Build your own 135-piece 3D model of Croke Park. No glue or tools needed! A must-have for GAA fans aged 7+ at Cogs Toys & Games Ireland.
pages.ld_description:
Croke Park 3D Puzzle


Officially licensed 3D puzzle of Croke Park stadium, perfect for GAA fans of all ages. 🏟️


Contains 135 durable pieces with precise detailing—no scissors, tools, or glue required.


Recommended for ages 7+; not suitable for children under 36 months due to small parts (choking hazard).


Average build time is around 2 hours, making it a great family or collector’s project.


Completed model measures 38cm x 34cm x 9cm and is a true-to-life replica.


This Croke Park puzzle celebrates Ireland’s iconic GAA stadium, offering hours of rewarding, hands-on building fun for sports fans. 🌟
